description: Controller-style roles that apply financial-reporting controls to sustainability data; present at more than half of Fortune 100 companies (2024).

US demand driven by California limited assurance (2026) moving to reasonable (2030); EU dropped its planned reasonable-assurance step; CARB has not yet fixed provider qualifications.

Time-and-materials billing monetizes hours; AI-compressed drafting pushes firms toward fixed-fee or value pricing or margin compression.

role_title: Utility Wildfire Mitigation Analyst / Program Manager
description: Wildfire mitigation planning, public-safety power shutoff decisions and ignition-risk modeling became a distinct utility function, spreading across western utilities.
LiDAR, satellite and AI prioritization reduce routine patrols and shift work to validating model-flagged risks; still a major entry path for forestry graduates.
Hiring is volatile with 2025 federal tax-credit and federal-land approval changes; state permitting and transmission work may absorb some demand.
Role splitting into origination/landowner engagement, methodology/integrity science and dMRV engineering as integrity scrutiny and remote sensing mature.
Remote-sensing and ML scientists quantify carbon/nature outcomes for developers, raters and buyers; ground-truth and uncertainty design are the durable skills.
State producer-responsibility and chemical reporting laws create compliance roles distinct from voluntary circular-economy strategy.
Records review and report writing are highly automatable; fee-compressed product; site visit and environmental-professional judgment remain.
EHS software vendors are embedding AI (NAEM 2026 benchmark sponsored by them); compliance tracking and incident analytics augmented; certifying-official accountability unchanged.

description: Movement of 2025-26 separated federal staff into private consulting and contracting is plausible but was not evidenced in this session; BLS medians imply many such moves are pay cuts for science roles. CM/LM should test with career-transition data.
